name: Ramp
text: We should add a 4px solid focus ring in color #005fcc to every interactive element that can be focused, because this provides a clear visual indicator for users navigating with a keyboard. This decision ensures that users with visual or motor impairments can easily identify which element currently has focus, making the interface more accessible. By choosing a 4px solid ring, we're accepting a slight trade-off in design simplicity, but it's worth it for the significant gain in usability for keyboard-only users. This focus ring will also help with mobile and touch navigation, as it provides a clear target for users to tap on.

name: Reader
text: A 4px solid focus ring risks disappearing on semi-transparent or textured backgrounds, creating a muddy halo. A two-layer ring (4px #005fcc + 2px white) would work better, but only if tested on live backgrounds. Settle it by checking contrast ratios on actual UI samples.
